'''2000 Australasian Continental Championship''' was the Star Wars CCG Australasian Continental Championship of 2000. Its champion qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Ben Isaacs]] of Sydney won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Continental championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] or [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (date not found; Death Star II became tournament-legal on 19 July 2000)<ref name="rl00facts">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/regionals2000/basicfacts.html Championship Circuit 2000: basic facts], Decipher (Regional Championships "June 1 - September 3"; Continental Championships "Summer Con season", Europe and Australasia "not yet determined"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231959/http://www.decipher.com:80/tournaments/regionals2000/basicfacts.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' 16 July 2000<ref name="tr-d1013" />
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia<ref name="tr-d1013" />
